name: DeepProtein
description: Deep learning has deeply influenced protein science, enabling breakthroughs in predicting protein properties, higher-order structures, and molecular interactions. This paper introduces DeepProtein, a comprehensive and user-friendly deep learning library tailored for protein-related tasks. It enables researchers to seamlessly address protein data with cutting-edge deep learning models. To assess model performance, we establish a benchmark evaluating different deep learning architectures across multiple protein-related tasks, including protein function prediction, subcellular localization prediction, protein-protein interaction prediction, and protein structure prediction. Furthermore, we introduce DeepProt-T5, a series of fine-tuned Prot-T5-based models that achieve state-of-the-art performance on four benchmark tasks, while demonstrating competitive results on six of others. evaluation_method: accuracy, F1, AUROC, and related classification/regression metrics depending on the task
typical_sota_score: varies by task; typically ~65–98% depending on metric and specific protein task
reputation: A useful open-source protein deep learning benchmark/library that is more of a research toolkit than a widely standardized community leaderboard.
notes: Covers heterogeneous protein tasks with different metrics and dataset splits; results are not directly comparable across tasks and some tasks may be small or imbalanced.
